12: class Cache:
13:     """Utility for caching iterables.
14: 
15:     This can be used to save a stream of data to the disk in order to iterate over it faster the
16:     following time. This can save time depending on the nature of stream. The more processing
17:     happens in a stream, the more time will be saved. Even in the case where no processing is done
18:     apart from reading the data, the cache will save some time because it is using the pickle
19:     binary protocol. It can thus improve the speed in common cases such as reading from a CSV file.
20: 
21:     Parameters
22:     ----------
23:     directory
24:         The path where to store the pickled data streams. If not provided, then it will be
25:         automatically inferred whenever possible, if not an exception will be raised.
26: 
27:     Attributes
28:     ----------
29:     keys : set
30:         The set of keys that are being cached.
31: 
32:     Examples
33:     --------
34: 
35:     >>> import time
36:     >>> from river import datasets
37:     >>> from river import stream
38: 
39:     >>> dataset = datasets.Phishing()
40:     >>> cache = stream.Cache()
41: 
42:     The cache can be used by wrapping it around an iterable. Because this is the first time
43:     are iterating over the data, nothing is cached.
44: 
45:     >>> tic = time.time()
46:     >>> for x, y in cache(dataset, key='phishing'):
47:     ...     pass
48:     >>> toc = time.time()
49:     >>> print(toc - tic)  # doctest: +SKIP
50:     0.012813
51: 
52:     If we do the same thing again, we can see the loop is now faster.
53: 
54:     >>> tic = time.time()
55:     >>> for x, y in cache(dataset, key='phishing'):
56:     ...     pass
57:     >>> toc = time.time()
58:     >>> print(toc - tic)  # doctest: +SKIP
59:     0.001927
60: 
61:     We can see an overview of the cache. The first line indicates the location of the
62:     cache.
63: 
64:     >>> cache  # doctest: +SKIP
65:     /tmp
66:     phishing - 125.2KiB
67: 
68:     Finally, we can clear the stream from the cache.
69: 
70:     >>> cache.clear('phishing')
71:     >>> cache  # doctest: +SKIP
72:     /tmp
73: 
74:     There is also a `clear_all` method to remove all the items in the cache.
75: 
76:     >>> cache.clear_all()
77: 
78:     """
79: 
80:     def __init__(self, directory=None):
81:         # Guess the directory from the system
82:         system = platform.system()
83:         if directory is None:
84:             directory = {"Linux": "/tmp", "Darwin": "/tmp", "Windows": "C:\\TEMP"}.get(system)
85: 
86:         if directory is None:
87:             raise ValueError(
88:                 f"There is no default directory defined for {system} systems, "
89:                 "please provide one manually"
90:             )
91: 
92:         self.directory = directory
93:         self.keys = set()
94: 
95:         # Check if there is anything already in the cache
96:         for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(self.directory, "*.river_cache.pkl")):
97:             key = os.path.basename(f).split(".")[0]
98:             self.keys.add(key)
99: 
100:     def _get_path(self, key):
101:         return os.path.join(self.directory, f"{key}.river_cache.pkl")
102: 
103:     def __call__(self, stream, key=None):
104:         # Try to guess a key from the stream object
105:         if key is None:
106:             if inspect.isfunction(stream):
107:                 key = stream.__name__
108: 
109:         if key is None:
110:             raise ValueError(
111:                 "No default key could be guessed for the given stream, please provide one"
112:             )
113: 
114:         path = self._get_path(key)
115: 
116:         if os.path.exists(path):
117:             yield from self[key]
118:             return
119: 
120:         with open(path, "wb") as f:
121:             pickler = pickle.Pickler(f)
122:             for el in stream:
123:                 pickler.dump(el)
124:                 yield el
125:             self.keys.add(key)
126: 
127:     def __getitem__(self, key):
128:         """Iterates over the stream associated with the given key."""
129:         with open(self._get_path(key), "rb") as f:
130:             unpickler = pickle.Unpickler(f)
131:             while f.peek(1):
132:                 yield unpickler.load()
133: 
134:     def clear(self, key: str):
135:         """Delete the cached stream associated with the given key.
136: 
137:         Parameters
138:         ----------
139:         key
140: 
141:         """
142:         os.remove(self._get_path(key))
143:         self.keys.remove(key)
144: 
145:     def clear_all(self):
146:         """Delete all the cached streams."""
147:         for key in list(self.keys):
148:             os.remove(self._get_path(key))
149:             self.keys.remove(key)
150: 
151:     def __repr__(self):
152:         return "\n".join(
153:             [self.directory]
154:             + [
155:                 f"{key} - {utils.pretty.humanize_bytes(os.path.getsize(self._get_path(key)))}"
156:                 for key in self.keys
157:             ]
158:         )
